test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of parliamentary government in India?

options.text: Membership of the ministers in the legislature,
Presence of nominal and real executives
Collective responsibility of the executive to the legislature

solution:
The correct answer is __**Undissolvable lower house**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the Parliamentary system, the head of the state may be a monarch or a President, but both of these positions are ceremonial.
 
• The head of the government, who is generally called the Prime Minister, is the real head.
 
• Thus all the real executive powers are vested in the Prime Minister.
 
• Articles 74 and 75 deal with the parliamentary system at the centre and Articles 163 and Article 164 deal with the Parliamentary system at the states.
 
• **Elements and features of a Parliamentary system are:-**
 
 
• Nominal and Real head.
 
• The executive is a part of the Legislature
 
• Majority party rule
 
• Collective responsibility
 
• The prime minister is the centre of power
 
• A Parliamentary opposition
 
• Independent Civil Service
 
• Bicameral Legislature
 
• Secrecy
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **In the parliamentary form of government, there will be no separation of powers.**
 
• Here the executive will be part of the legislature.
 
• In the case of the presidential form of **government, legislative and executive are separate from each other.**
 
• The most defining feature of the parliamentary form of government: **the executive is answerable to the legislature, unlike the presidential form of government, where the executive is not answerable to the legislature. **
 
• **The parliamentary form of government defines the governing mechanism of the state and the division of power is not decided by the form of government.**
